label: Subtitle Burn
description: Reads subtitle cues from an MKV/MP4's embedded subtitle stream (text-based codecs) and burns them onto the video as m0saic text overlays. Opt-in cue emission via MosaicDataSource + doc.sidecars.cues.

sourceId.label: Source
sourceId.description: Source id in ctx.media. Defaults to first video with subtitles.

languageCode.label: Language
languageCode.description: Preferred subtitle language (e.g. "eng", "spa"). 2-letter and locale-suffix forms accepted.

fallbackToDefault.label: Fallback to default
fallbackToDefault.description: When languageCode misses, fall back to default-flagged or first track. Default true.

trackIndex.label: Track
trackIndex.description: Explicit subtitle track index (overrides languageCode when set).

emitCues.label: Emit cues
emitCues.description: Publish extracted cues as a MosaicDataSource (pipeline-readable) AND doc.sidecars.cues (written to {basename}.cues.json).

clipStartMs.label: Clip start
clipStartMs.description: Source-relative ms where the rendered segment starts. Paired with clipEndMs.

clipEndMs.label: Clip end
clipEndMs.description: Source-relative ms where the rendered segment ends. Must be > clipStartMs.

clipLoopMode.label: Clip loop mode
clipLoopMode.description: How the clipped source fills ctx.target.durationMs when shorter.

borderWidth.label: Border Width
borderWidth.description: Outline width as a fraction of min(w,h).
